我们蜂巢的义体化正在顺利进行中。我们的一部分人口现在已经搭载了义体植入体，而另一部分则还是完全的生物体。我们从未体在自己的身体上验过这样强烈的差异。工蜂现在可以将自己识别为不同群体的一部分，这种分裂感正在诱发它们的个体意识。

有些工蜂开始向自己身上安装小配件以装饰自己，或在植入体上绘制特殊符号以区分彼此。真是一种有趣但又令人担忧的发展。
texts.en:
The cyberization of our Hive is continuing smoothly. Part of our population now carries cybernetic implants, while others are still completely biological. Never before have we experienced such striking differences between our selves. Drones are now able to identify themselves as part of one or the other group, and this split is expanding their sense of individuality.

Some drones have started to adorn themselves with small accessories, or are painting symbols on their implants to tell each other apart. It's an intriguing, yet unnerving development.

summary.text:
# 一种人口，两个群体 / One Population, Two Groups

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 蜂巢版网络化局势（Cyberization）每月从 on_cyberization_hive_situation_random_events_list 等权重抽取一个满足条件的随机事件（共6个：2220、2260、2320、2360、2420、2460）；事件期间设置 situation_cyberization_pause。
  The hive version of the Cyberization situation draws one valid event with equal weight monthly from on_cyberization_hive_situation_random_events_list (six events: 2220, 2260, 2320, 2360, 2420, 2460); the event sets situation_cyberization_pause while open.
- 触发：局势进度>500；每局至多一次。
  Trigger: situation progress > 500; at most once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「一个族群，两个群体」（挑战）：三个选项各给1800天的修正——cyber_hive_individual_drones、cyber_hive_no_individual_drones、cyber_hive_individual_leader_drones。
  "One Population, Two Groups" (challenge): three options each granting a 1800-day modifier: cyber_hive_individual_drones, cyber_hive_no_individual_drones, cyber_hive_individual_leader_drones.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:6692-6788`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`
- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
